## Scope

Describe the evidence, decision, screenplay, validation, governance or
production-design change and list every affected permanent ID and scene.

## Rights declaration

- [ ] I created the submitted material or have documented authority to submit it.
- [ ] I have not included protected scans, full copyrighted translations, confidential material or unlicensed images.
- [ ] I permit the repository owner to store, review, modify and display this contribution as part of this repository under its current fully reserved interim rights state.
- [ ] I understand that submitting or accepting this pull request does not transfer or grant film, television, stage, publication, merchandising or other production rights unless a separate written agreement says so.
- [ ] I identified all third-party material and its rights status.

## Validation

List the exact commands executed and their results. Do not mark a check as
passed when it was not run against the proposed commit.

## Open gates

List specialist, actor, terminology, source, rights or owner decisions that
remain open. A merged pull request does not imply those approvals.
